mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = r.app_id AND a.code = 'workspace' AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id AND rm.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = r.app_id AND a.code = 'workspace' AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.app_code = 'workspace' AND m.status = 1 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission <> ''

SELECT t.name AS "tenantName", d.dept_name AS "deptName" FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0
